title: An indented comment that ends the stream goes with the last entry when it is removed
notes: A comment line directly after an entry and indented more than its key belongs to that entry, even when the entry is the last one (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments). Here `# note` is indented under `k` and nothing follows it, so it goes with the entry, and the emptied root mapping is written `{}`. YAML gives comments no owner, so the bytes rest on the kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend wrote `{}` and the pure backend left the comment behind.
